text:
james_support: Heads up — AcadiaCloud reported a new API key visible in the console but all API calls return 403 JSON {\"error\":\"insufficient_scope\"}. They say it was created during onboarding via OIDC. Can infra/provisioning check the key's project/scope?

acadia_ops: We created the key through the console during the 'acadia-prod' onboarding flow (org: acadia-org). Key shows up as 'acadia-prod-key' in UI. Sample error from their side: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <KEY>\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` returns 403 and body: `{\"error\":\"insufficient_scope\"}`

provisioner-bot: provisioner: created api_key id: ak_live_01X for onboarding job 7821, assigned scopes: [read:models] (no write/generate scopes). Project tagged: project-slug: acadia-prod (?mapping=acadia-sandbox)

ryan_eng: Thanks — can you paste the exact console key id (not the obscured token) and a screenshot of the project dropdown? My initial guess: key was created but bound to the wrong project or got a narrow scope from the provisioning profile.

acadia_ops: Key id visible in console: ak_live_01X, screenshot: (uploaded). It definitely lists name = \"acadia-prod-key\" and project dropdown shows \"acadia-prod\".

ryan_eng: Sending quick repro curl (using the id shown):

```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_TOKEN>" \\n  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

Response headers/body: `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden` + `{\"error\":\"insufficient_scope\"}`.

milla_sre: I checked the provisioning audit: the mapping rule that selects target project for new orgs was recently updated (rule id rm-7). It contains a fallback mapping to `acadia-sandbox` when org metadata key `prod_flag` is missing. Looks like the onboarding flow didn't include prod_flag so the job defaulted. The console UI then rendered the display name as 'acadia-prod' because of a naming alias — confusing.

ryan_eng: That matches. provisioner-bot also logged `mapping=acadia-sandbox` above. Two options: 1) reassign the existing key to the correct project and add proper scopes, 2) rotate and issue a new key created explicitly for acadia-prod with scopes [read:models, generate:text]. Reassign is faster but must be done carefully (audit + rotation recommended).

provisioner-bot: Reassign attempt: `rb-provision reassign-key --id ak_live_01X --project acadia-prod` -> ERROR: permission_denied: service-account lacks iam.roles/key_admin.

milla_sre: I'll escalate to infra-iam to grant temporary role to the provisioner SA to perform the rebind, or we can create a new key under the correct project immediately (safer and easier). Recommend creating new key and marking old key for rotation + disable in 10m. 

ryan_eng: Agreed. James, can you generate a new onboarding key for Acadia with explicit scopes and send it to them with instructions to swap? Do not send the token in channel, DM only.

james_support: Creating new key now via console for project `acadia-prod` with scopes: read:models, generate:text. New key id: ak_temp_9ab (token sent to customer via DM). Please test and report back. ETA ~2 minutes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

acadia_ops: Got the new token via DM. Testing...

acadia_ops: SUCCESS — `HTTP/1.1 200 OK` and valid generation response. Thanks, that worked.

james_support: Root cause: onboarding mapping fallback assigned new org to staging project due to missing prod_flag in metadata. Action items: (1) milla to file infra ticket to adjust mapping rule and add a validation to onboarding flow (2) ryan to add a post-provision check that verifies scopes include generate permissions before surfacing token in UI (3) rotate old key ak_live_01X and mark disabled. I'll follow up in an incident ticket. :white_check_mark:

milla_sre: Filed ticket INF-1142 to update mapping rule and add a unit test. Also added a temporary dashboard alert to catch prod_flag omissions.

ryan_eng: I'll add the post-provision scope assertion in the onboarding job. PR to follow.

provisioner-bot: Audit log entry created: reassign_attempt by jenkins-provisioner sa at 1745003342 -> denied.

acadia_ops: Confirming app back in production using new key. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

james_support: Closing thread — will update incident INF-1142 with timeline and postmortem once changes merge. If anything else pops up ping me or @ryan_eng. :thumbsup:
